title: Generic Construction of Odd-Dimension Boolean Functions
summary: The authors are not aware of a generic construction for odd input lengths with such a low absolute indicator, so finding one remains unresolved.

formal_statement.body: For every odd $m$, construct $f:\mathbb{F}_2^m\to\mathbb{F}_2$ with optimal or near-optimal $M(f)$.

scope.domain: Boolean-function constructions over binary vector spaces, with absolute indicator as the quality measure.
parameters: M(f), the absolute-indicator target, sought to be optimal or near-optimal
scope.unresolved_remainder: Find a generic construction for every odd input dimension whose absolute indicator is optimal or near-optimal.
